'''2011 Belgium Regionals Richard Andichon DS Hoth''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Richard Andichon]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Dark)|Hoth-D-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hoth & Spicy
* '''Username:''' AKA FrenchGalak
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
